name: mycrew
description: A four-layer harness for Claude Code: house rules and primitives, a build pipeline, a product plane with its task board, and the crew that drives them. Install mycrew-tools first.

plugins.name: mycrew-tools
plugins.description: Layer 1/4 — small, project-agnostic skills you reach for mid-work, plus the house rule files the rest of mycrew builds on.

plugins.name: mycrew-pipeline
plugins.description: Layer 2/4 — the build pipeline: six stages carry one task from a decision to hardened, reviewed, tested code, each skipping itself when the change doesn't earn it.

plugins.name: mycrew-product
plugins.description: Layer 3/4 — the product plane and its task board, both kept on backlog.md: what the whole product must do, and what is being done about it right now. /product-init stands it up.

plugins.name: mycrew-crew
plugins.description: Layer 4/4 — the crew that builds the product: a chief who is the human's deputy over the whole product, a lead who holds one feature, a worker who carries one assignment. Each hands work to the next; only the worker writes code.
